title: Fragments of SRP, the nonstationary ideal, and diagonal reflection
summary: We investigate the relationships between fragments of SRP and diagonal reflection principles. It turns out that the subcomplete fragment of SRP, augmented with CH, implies that the nonstationary ideal on $ω_1$ is not saturated, but that Larson's diagonal reflection principle $OSR_{ω_2}$ holds. In contrast, it was known that the full principle SRP implies the saturation of the nonstationary ideal on $ω_1$, but it does not imply $OSR_{ω_2}$.
